name: Super Safe for Work
source:
Su-hee has finally finished her probationary period at her new job.

Now that she's harder to fire, she feels more comfortable being herself in the office environment. She's had her eye on an older co-worker on another team for a while now. Can Su-hee win the affection of the elegant Areum?

[From [url=https://railgunrabbit.itch.io/super-safe-for-work]itch.io[/url]]
